messages.author: Gustaf Olsson
messages.body:
What happens if you open a browser and try to visit continuum.io<
http://continuum.io
>?
The adress seems to redirect to anaconda.com<
http://anaconda.com
>, still I do not see any certificate errors. If you are unable to connect to this website using a browser I would assume that this has something to do with a local key/certificate issue or an overly aggressive security setting from your firewall or ISP.
Try just visiting the web-adress with a browser first, does that work? If not, then if you are trying to do this on a computer on a university/organisation network, contact the IT dept.
Best regards
// Gustaf
